title: rPPG Program
title_zh: 非接觸式生理訊號量測
tagline: Contactless measurement of physiological signals from face video with an ordinary camera.
tagline_zh: 用一般攝影機從臉部影像做非接觸式生理訊號量測。

title: MLLM Program
title_zh: 多模態情緒理解與同理回應
tagline: Multimodal language models that read face, voice and physiology to recognize emotion and respond with empathy.
tagline_zh: 讀取臉部、語音與生理訊號的多模態語言模型，辨識情緒並以同理心回應。

title: CAG Program
title_zh: 冠狀動脈攝影 AI 判讀
tagline: Reads coronary angiograms in the order cardiologists do and drafts a standardized, traceable report.
tagline_zh: 依醫師判讀順序分析冠狀動脈攝影，產出可追溯、標準化的診斷報告草稿。
